prompt: A short guide to UX Woz, a tool that turns one sentence into a clickable mockup. Home lists six lessons as cards: Describe your product, Pick one of two designs, Click anything to draw the next screen, Change a screen in plain words with Edit, Rules and Components keep every screen consistent, and Share a link to get feedback. Each lesson is its own screen with a small sketch of that step, two sentences that explain it, and a Next button to the following lesson. The last lesson ends with a button that says Now describe your own.
